description: Adds an email address to one form, identified by its name from the action path. New forms notify the organization owners until changed. Organization members and website editors receive submissions immediately; other addresses get a confirmation email (link valid 7 days). `member` and `confirmed` addresses receive email; `pending` addresses must confirm by link; `failing` addresses bounced or complained; `stopped` addresses opted out. Works before the first submission; at most 20 addresses per website.

formName.description: The form name from the action path.

name: websiteForms_recipients_add
title: Add a notification recipient to a form
